_description: Draft label map between the WardWatch testbed classes and CICIoMT2024 (WiFi_and_MQTT) labels, shared classes only. Used to align labels for the cross-dataset work (Experiment C: our shared extractor on CIC pcaps; Experiment D: CIC's own feature CSVs + official split). Drafted 2026-11-04 from the CIC labels present on disk; NOT an Experiment-C design.

cic_source.label_encoding: per-file (attack name is the filename stem, e.g. ARP_Spoofing_train.pcap.csv)
cic_source.row_semantics: one row = aggregate statistics over a packet group/flow (columns Number/AVG/Std/IAT/Covariance/Weight confirm per-group aggregation, not per-packet)
cic_source.identifier_or_time_columns: none (no timestamp, IP, MAC, host or flow-key column; 'IPv' is an IP-version protocol indicator, not an address)
cic_source.pcap_blocker: registration wall (train_listing.html = 'Registration required'); only CIC's extracted-feature CSVs were downloaded

recon_scan.note: Generic reconnaissance; our recon_scan is an nmap-style scan.

syn_flood.note: CIC separates DoS vs DDoS (single vs many sources); our testbed uses a single fixed source, so it is closest to the DoS-SYN variants but we include DDoS-SYN for completeness.

mqtt_flood.note: Our mqtt_flood is connect/publish flooding; CIC splits connect vs publish and DoS vs DDoS.

arp_mitm.note: SEMANTIC GAP: CIC's ARP_Spoofing is spoofing only; our arp_mitm additionally forwards/relays traffic (full MITM). Shared at the ARP-anomaly level, not identical.

_testbed_only_note: No CIC equivalent: CIC has no MQTT credential brute-force and no stolen-credential abuse (wildcard eavesdropping, spoofed vitals, unauthorised pump commands). These are testbed-specific and cannot appear in a shared-class cross-dataset experiment.
_cic_only_note: Present in CIC, absent from our testbed. For a binary attack-vs-normal cross-dataset test these all map to 'attack'; they have no shared multiclass label with the testbed.
caveats: Feature spaces differ: CIC = 45 aggregate per-packet-group stats with no identifiers/time; testbed = one row per host-MAC per 5 s window with MQTT-semantic (topic-derived, client-id reuse) and L2/ARP features. Experiment C requires running our shared extractor on CIC PCAPs (absent). Experiment D uses CIC's own 45-col CSVs.
This file maps labels only; it does not define the shared feature subset or any Experiment-C design (parked until the CIC pcaps are available).
